name: If You Love Somebody Set Them Free

info.album: The Very Best Of Sting And The Police

podcast.body: This song was the first single from Sting's solo debut album "The Dream of the Blue Turtles." It featured Sting playing with all Black performers in the video, including R&B backing vocalists Dolet McDonald and Janice Pendarvus. Intended as an antidote to "Every Breath You Take," it focused on letting go rather than control. It rose to number three on the Hot 100, number one on the album Rock Chart, and number 17 on the R&B chart. "If you love somebody, set them free, was Jazzy R&B."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
